title: Multi-Objective Protein Optimization via Modular Diffusion Steering
abstract: arXiv:2610.28943v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Protein engineering often requires improving several properties simultaneously, motivating the search for high-performing sequences that represent useful fitness tradeoffs. Discovering these sequences is challenging because the design space is combinatorially large and experimental campaigns often permit only a few rounds of batched measurements. We introduce \textit{MODS}, a modular framework for multi-objective protein optimization via inference-time diffusion steering. For each proposal, MODS samples augmented Chebyshev scalarization weights and a fitness-surrogate ensemble member to define a scalar steering reward. Varying the weights directs generation toward different objective tradeoffs, while varying ensemble members diversifies the predictions used for guidance. Because MODS expresses multi-objective acquisition through scalar rewards, it can be paired with different diffusion models and compatible steering procedures. After eac

translated_title: 基于模块化扩散引导的多目标蛋白质优化
translated_abstract: 蛋白质工程通常需要同时改进多个性质，这促使人们寻找代表有用适应性权衡的高性能序列。发现这些序列具有挑战性，因为设计空间在组合意义上极其庞大，且实验活动通常只允许进行少数几轮的批量测量。我们提出了MODS，一个通过推理时扩散引导进行多目标蛋白质优化的模块化框架。对于每个候选提案，MODS通过采样增强的切比雪夫标量化权重和一个适应性代理集成成员来定义标量引导奖励。改变权重可以将生成过程引导向不同的目标权衡，而改变集成成员则可以使用于引导的预测多样化。由于MODS通过标量奖励来表达多目标获取策略，因此它可以与不同的扩散模型及兼容的引导程序配对使用。在每一……（摘要不完整，原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出MODS框架，通过推理时扩散引导结合采样的切比雪夫标量化权重和代理集成预测，实现模块化的多目标蛋白质优化，可灵活搭配不同扩散模型以发现多种性质权衡下的高性能蛋白质序列。
